title: Emergence of cuspons through wave breaking
summary: We study the emergence of cuspons through wave breaking, with the Camassa--Holm equation as a principal model. For a broad open class of smooth initial data, the first singularity occurs at a unique point and has the sharp local Hölder regularity \(C^{3/5}\). We construct a continuation of the Lagrangian flow through this singular time and reconstruct from it a conservative Eulerian weak solution. We show that the first singularity does not simply persist after breaking; instead, it bifurcates immediately into an anticuspon--cuspon pair, each having the sharp local Hölder regularity…
